tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump softkey reachable from the Controls screen
tcs.test_item:
The Third Row Headrest Dump softkey shall be accessible from the Controls screen and shall remain in an enabled state when the feature is available.

(Entry path: Controls screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the third row head restraint dump feature
2. The HU is on the home screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Controls screen from the Menu Bar
2. Check that the "Headrest Dump" softkey button is displayed and enabled on the Controls screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Controls screen is displayed
2. The "Headrest Dump" softkey button is displayed and enabled

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之進入路徑為 Controls 畫面；-027 之進入路徑為 Rear View Camera 畫面。

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump softkey reachable from the Rear View Camera screen
tcs.test_item:
The Third Row Headrest Dump softkey shall also be accessible from the Rear View Camera screen, when supported.

(Entry path: Rear View Camera screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the third row head restraint dump feature
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The HU is on the home screen
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the Rear View Camera screen from the Menu Bar
2. Check that the "Headrest Dump" softkey button is displayed on the Rear View Camera screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Rear View Camera screen is displayed
2. The "Headrest Dump" softkey button is displayed

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之進入路徑為 Rear View Camera 畫面且以 PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present) 為前提；-026 之進入路徑為 Controls 畫面。

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump softkey selectable at ignition lock
tcs.test_item:
The HMI shall make the Third Row Headrest Dump softkey selectable when $PowerMode$ = [Ignition Lock / IGN_LK].

(PowerMode = IGN_LK)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the third row head restraint dump feature
2. The Controls screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 0 (Initialization)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK) and check that the "Headrest Dump" softkey button is selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 0 (Initialization) is sent
2. The "Headrest Dump" softkey button is selectable

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之 CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK)，軟鍵可選；-032 之 CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)，同為可選但觸發值不同。

tcs.tc_title: Headrest Dump softkey selectable at ignition run
tcs.test_item:
The HMI shall make the Third Row Headrest Dump softkey selectable when $PowerMode$ = [Ignition Run / IGN_RUN].

(PowerMode = IGN_RUN)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with the third row head restraint dump feature
2. The Controls screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 0 (Initialization)
2. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) and check that the "Headrest Dump" softkey button is selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 0 (Initialization) is sent
2. The "Headrest Dump" softkey button is selectable

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之 CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)，軟鍵可選；-030 之 CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK)，同為可選但觸發值不同。

tcs.tc_title: Rear View Camera button activated when camera is present
tcs.test_item:
If the HMI receives the $RVC_SK_PRSNT$ = [Present] the HMI shall activate the virtual Rear View Camera button for user select-ability.

(Rear View Camera present)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
2. The Controls screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Power cycle the HU so that PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present) is applied
2. Check that the virtual "Rear View Camera" button is displayed and selectable on the Controls screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The HU completes start-up and the Controls screen is displayed
2. The virtual "Rear View Camera" button is displayed and selectable

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之觸發為 PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present) 之配置；-038 之觸發為 CmdIgnSts 之電源模式。

tcs.tc_title: Rear View Camera button selectable only at ignition run
tcs.test_item:
The Rear View Camera soft button shall be selectable only when $PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN].

(PowerMode = IGN_RUN, camera present)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
2. The Controls screen is displayed
3. CAN-B is connected to the bus simulator
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK)
2. Read the state of the virtual "Rear View Camera" button and check that it is not selectable
3. Send CAN: STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) and check that the virtual "Rear View Camera" button is selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts = 1 (IGN_LK) is sent
2. The virtual "Rear View Camera" button reads not selectable
3. The virtual "Rear View Camera" button is selectable

distinguishing_axis.delta: 本列之驗證對象為 Rear View Camera 軟鍵於 CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN) 之可選性；-032 之驗證對象為 Headrest Dump 軟鍵。

reasoning: 本批自 Common Features 之 32 個未用可用 leaf 中依 reqid 升冪取 10，其中 4 條因來源缺件而移出（見 blocked_pending_dr.json），實際交付 6 條。驗證目標為第三排頭枕下放軟鍵之可及性（Controls 畫面／Rear View Camera 畫面）、其於各電源模式之可選性、以及 Rear View Camera 虛擬鍵之啟用條件。關鍵情境條件以 CAN-B 之 $STATUS_BH_BCM2.CmdIgnSts$ 與 PROXI Rear_View_Camera 驅動；CmdIgnSts 之值取 DBC VAL_ 逐字（0 Initialization／1 IGN_LK／4 RUN）。切分依 §4.6 之 sibling 比對：11 列（含 batch01_v3 之 -025）逐列比對 trigger 與 verification target，無 duplicate_of；每條輸出 distinguishing_axis，軸為 mode（進入路徑）／trigger_state（電源模式值）／input_data（PROXI 配置）。未涵蓋者：-028（VC_HdRstPrsnt 無匯流排對應）、-029（IGN_START 無對應）、-031（IGN_OFF_ACC 無對應）、-039（未具名之 HMI Logic and Flow 交叉參照）四條移出本批。
